slides.title: Prdivý závod
slides.text: How to play – a serious instructional film

slides.title: The sport
slides.text: You are an athlete. Your discipline: collecting farts in a backpack and releasing them where it counts. First to deliver 15 wins. Yes, really.

slides.title: Getting started
slides.text: Choose “Hrát sám”. It means “play alone” – which is how anyone who farts this much ends up anyway.

slides.title: On a computer
slides.text: W A S D: run.   Mouse: look around innocently.   Shift: sprint.   Space: jump – purely for dramatic effect.

slides.title: On a phone
slides.text: Left thumb: run.   Right thumb: look.   SKOK: jump.   Your thumbs have trained for this their whole lives.

slides.title: Collect
slides.text: See the glowing green clouds? Walk into them. Do not try this at home. The backpack holds 8 – science cannot explain how.

slides.title: Let it go
slides.text: Stand under the orange hood and hold the left mouse button. On a phone it happens by itself. The hood has seen things.

slides.title: Blast a rival
slides.text: Aim at a rival and press the right mouse button – PRD! on a phone. It costs 2 farts. They vanish in a green cloud for 10 seconds. They will not thank you.

slides.title: After 45 seconds…
slides.text: …the lights go out. That smell? For once, it is not you.

slides.title: Meet the fart monster
slides.text: It cannot be reasoned with. Sprint – walking is too slow – or blast it for 2 farts. It hates the taste of its own medicine.

slides.title: If it catches you
slides.text: It eats your whole backpack. Rude.

slides.title: Bring a friend
slides.text: One device sets up a game and shows a code; the other joins on the same Wi-Fi, or over Bluetooth. The friendship may not survive.

slides.title: Victory
slides.text: First to 15 wins and may call themselves champion. Quietly. Then press R – or tap – and do it all again.
